verses.mystical_translation: I will praise you, O the Living Presence, with my whole heart; I will show forth all your marvellous works.
I will be glad and rejoice in you: I will sing praise to your name, O you most High.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
For you have maintained my right and my cause; you satest in the throne judging right.
You have rebuked the nations, you have destroyed the patterns rooted in harm, you have put out their name for ever and ever.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
But the the Living Presence shall endure for ever: he has prepared his throne for judgment.
And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
The the Living Presence also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
And they that know your name will put their trust in you: for you, the Living Presence, hast not forsaken them that seek you.
Sing praises to the the Living Presence, which dwelleth in Zion, the holy center: declare among the people his doings.
When he makes inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
Have mercy upon me, O the Living Presence; consider my trouble which I suffer of them that hate me, you that liftest me up from the gates of death:
That I may show forth all your praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion, the holy center: I will rejoice in your deliverance and wholeness.
The nations are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
The the Living Presence is known by the judgment which he executeth: the patterns rooted in harm is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
The patterns rooted in harm return to Sheol—all nations that forget the Divine.
Contemplatively, this verse gives voice to the longing that violence, deceit, domination, and fear lose their power; it is not a directive against human enemies.
Arise, O the Living Presence; let not man prevail: let the nations be judged in your sight.
Put them in fear, O the Living Presence: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

contemplative_note: The cry of the oppressed is not forgotten even when empires behave as though it is.
safety_note: Ancient nation-language cannot be transferred to modern ethnic or religious targets. Divine judgment is not human permission for collective punishment.
